name: SD: Electric delivery-van fleet (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: An electric delivery-van depot, counted every hour: parcels waiting, vans parked ready, vans out on routes, vans waiting for a charger, vans charging, vans in the workshop, and the energy the chargers have drawn. Some weeks a fast-charge bay is open. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the depot (the ground truth is in sd-ev-fleet/truth.model.json, including a stage the depot does not count), so discovery can be checked exactly. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
